prototype_feel_reasons: The selected bread asset retains a conspicuous white rectangular source background that does not match its rounded card or the surrounding UI.
Candidate dishes use inconsistent framing and visual footprints: some sit tightly within their cards while others appear small, faded, or close to the card edges.
The tiny status/rule marks beneath the tray look detached and arbitrarily positioned rather than intentionally integrated into a status panel.
Large gaps between the tray, status marks, colour controls, and candidate grid create an unbalanced mobile composition.
Opacity treatment on unavailable candidates is so strong that several dish assets appear washed out rather than deliberately disabled.
issues: candidate grid/selected bread — raw white rectangular image background is visibly pasted onto the card — remove the baked-in background or mask the asset to transparency and clip it consistently to the card radius
candidate cards — dish scale and placement vary noticeably across the 3x3 grid — use a shared image viewport with consistent object-fit: contain, normalized scale, and centered object-position

candidate grid/disabled dishes — heavy opacity reduction weakens focal-object visibility and makes artwork look unfinished — keep dish art more legible and communicate disabled state with a consistent card tint, lock treatment, or border
status marks below tray — tiny coloured dots float without a clear container or alignment relationship — place them in a defined status row and align them to the corresponding tray slots or legend

overall mobile composition — oversized blank vertical gaps separate related controls and assets — tighten spacing and establish clearer grouped sections between tray status, colour selector, and dish choices

candidate card framing — shadows, backgrounds, and corner treatment are too faint and inconsistent to firmly contain the artwork — apply one consistent card surface, radius, clipping mask, and shadow system
